quest.title: The Art of the Elegant Blade Dance?
quest.description: In a nondescript corner of Belleau Region, you and Paimon discover the entrance to a Domain. A Blade Dancer in high spirits extends a special invitation to you...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x20, Adventurer's Experience x2, Wanderer's Advice x4

dialogues.speaker: Costentin
dialogues.text: Haha! What luck that two fine-looking adventurers such as yourselves have run into me, Costentin, here today. It must be fate...

dialogues.speaker: Costentin
dialogues.text: So tell me, the pair of you — do you wish to revel in glorious combat?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Talk about out of the blue! Do you usually start conversations like this?

choices.text: Are you looking to pick a quarrel?

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: No no, I'm not challenging you two to a fight...

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: By "combat," I don't mean some frivolous venting of pent-up anger, nor some kind of highway robbery.

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: I'm talking about an ode to your inner passion, an artistic appreciation of the expression of your natural instincts!

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: Evolution has given us hands with which to grip our swords, so it's our duty to use them for their purpose: clenching a blade most beautiful and wielding it in an elegant dance of death!

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: As a pair of intrepid adventurers, I have no doubt that you'll be masters of this art!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uhh, you seem to be grasping the wrong end of the stick when it comes to combat... you're making it sound like the best thing since sliced bread!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Even though Paimon doesn't usually get involved, just seeing how {NICKNAME} deals with enemies is enough for her to know that fighting's really tough!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That's another thing, we haven't even told you who we are! How can you be so sure we're good at fighting?

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: Well, we're already quite some distance from the Court of Fontaine. How else could you have gotten here, if not by slaughtering every monster obstructing your path? By dropping out of the sky?

choices.text: Wrong! I know an even better way to travel!

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: Anyway, the aura emanating from you betrays how strong you are! I'm sure you've vanquished many powerful foes, and equally certain that you'll be very interested to hear about the one that resides in the Domain behind me...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, now we're back to familiar territory! Let Paimon guess, you were about to ask... "Would the two of you please demonstrate your prowess in combat for me?"

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: That's right! Would the two of you please demonstrate your prowess in combat for me? Pretty please?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Then our response is — Why don't you go do it yourself, huh?

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: Because when I went inside just now, I got beaten black and blue! Only you can't tell because I covered it up with makeup as quickly as I could.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon didn't expect you to just admit it like that!

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: There's no shame in defeat. After all, I'm only a writer, so naturally I'm not an expert fighter. I haven't been practicing for nearly long enough.

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: I only got the urge to put myself to the test after coming across stories about a certain "Blade Dancer" called Lafeinte while reading through some reference materials.

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: He likened combat to a dance of blades, and with the help of a certain talented engineer, had multiple arenas built where exquisite performances were held...

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: Such... consummate elegance!

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: Though he ended up in the Maison Gardiennage's bad books and had to flee Fontaine, stories of such legendary deeds make for gripping reading. I couldn't just let such top-notch source material go completely to waste!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So what you're saying is, you were trying to imitate a legendary figure...?

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: Exactly! I wanted to get into his head and understand his frame of mind. It took years of painstaking searching before I finally found this Domain.

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: It seems luck is with me! This must have been one of the arenas that the "Blade Dancer" built back in the day. If only someone could perform such a blade dance in the flesh and let me bear witness to the spectacle...

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: I'd be able to write a novel about a legendary swordsman, modeled after the "Blade Dancer" himself, and in so doing keep his elegance alive for posterity!

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: Of course, the two of you will certainly be richly rewarded for your trouble.

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: My writings would also be a written record of your hard work, which would itself become the stuff of legend, passed down far into the future... At least among novel enthusiasts...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #When you put it all fancy like that, Paimon's starting to feel curious... {NICKNAME}, whaddya say?

choices.text: I get to fight, and even get paid for it?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Good point... That means we're agreeing to help this swashbuckling novelist, right?

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: Woohoo! I knew you'd agree!

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: Then I'll leave it to you two! And don't you worry, I've hidden a Kamera in the Domain that will capture all of your heroics.

response.speaker: Costentin
response.text: Your promised reward will be waiting for you upon your triumphant return!

choices.text: Great job with the makeup, you nailed it!
Wrong! We jumped off the aquabus!
...Or just hungry for a knuckle sandwich?
